elements.description:
System posture and the emergency stop: what's running, a confirmed Stop that names what it halts, and the active
stops with Resume.

properties.name: posture
properties.description: The posture; unset follows the stops – a stop on everything is "stopped", any other stop "elevated"

properties.name: postureNote
properties.description: The line under the heading; unset says what the posture means

properties.name: stops
properties.description: The active stops. Changed by the user unless a tc-stop or tc-resume listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: postureLabels
properties.description: The postures' names, merged over the defaults (Normal, Elevated, Stopped)

properties.name: you
properties.description: Who a stop made here is by

properties.name: stopNote
properties.default: "Work in progress halts at its next step. Nothing is undone."
properties.description: What a stop does, said in the confirmation and next to Stop everything

properties.name: reasonLabel
properties.description: The reason field's label in the confirmation

properties.name: requireReason
properties.description: The confirmation needs a reason before Stop can be pressed

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-stop
events.description: A stop was confirmed ({ stop, halts, stops }: KillStopEvent – `stops` is the list with it added); cancelable – prevented, `stops` stays as it was

events.name: tc-resume
events.description: Resume was pressed on an active stop ({ stop, stops }: KillResumeEvent – `stops` is the list without it); cancelable – prevented, `stops` stays as it was

functions.name: defaultKillPostureLabels
functions.description: The postures' names used when the page gives none

props.name: stops
props.description: The active stops – controlled when given

props.name: defaultStops
props.description: The active stops on mount when `stops` isn't controlled

props.name: onStopsChange
props.description: The stops changed – a stop was confirmed or one resumed

props.name: onStop
props.description: A stop was confirmed: halt `halts` (or everything, for target "all")

props.name: onResume
props.description: Resume was pressed on a stop
